title: Fixed-beta Gibbs-weighted cancellation for the resolvent force term
question: Can the V'(q)f'(q) second-commutator term be paired by a fixed-beta one-site Gibbs integration-by-parts identity, replacing the divergent standalone K-form multiplier by f'' and the derivative-bearing history?

model.gibbs_pairing: omega_beta(V'f'h)=beta^(-1) omega_beta((f'h)') for h in C_c^1
model.history_interface: h is a one-site derivative-bearing history proxy; it is not the Q3 modular derivative delta D

adversarial_review.check: The identity is used only for compactly supported C1 history h with an explicit zero-boundary contract; no unproved boundary cancellation is promoted to the thermodynamic theory.
The estimate controls a fixed-beta Gibbs matrix element, not the squared V-weighted K-form norm that R308 obstructed.
The product rule produces f''h+f'h'; the history derivative is retained and is not identified silently with modular delta D.
The explicit beta^-1 factor is reported and no beta-uniform constant is asserted.
The fixture is one-site and finite-beta; no volume/source-uniform estimate or exhaustion rate is inferred.
Direct D/delta-D Cauchy, product/core density, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational polynomial identities and the beta envelope coefficient; it does not formalize Gibbs integration, boundary terms, modular derivatives, operator domains, or QFT limits.

qft_interface.closed: A fixed-beta one-site state-weighted linear pairing that transfers the force factor to f'' and a derivative-bearing history under a declared compact-support boundary contract.
qft_interface.open: Squared energy-form estimates, volume/source-uniform D/delta-D Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Positive route-local state-pairing result only; h is a history proxy and not the Q3 modular derivative.

no_overclaim: This supports a cancellation-aware fixed-beta matrix-element route. It neither repairs the R308 K-form obstruction nor proves a common infinite-volume QFT dynamics.
